user.description: Enter the charger ID (e.g. FA0123456) and PIN from the Accelev app or charger label. Both are sent to the EVTUN cloud API.

data_description.charger_id: Serial number of the charger, e.g. FA0123456
data_description.pin: 6-digit PIN shown in the Accelev app

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Accelev cloud API. Check your internet connection — the vendor server may also be down.
error.invalid_auth: The charger ID or PIN was rejected by the API.
error.cannot_parse: The API answered, but the response was not understood. Please report this with diagnostics.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

init.description: How often to poll the cloud API. The vendor API has tolerated 60 s polling for years; lower values increase the risk of rate limiting.

command_failed.message: Could not send the command to the charger: {error}

auth_failed.message: The Accelev API rejected the stored credentials. Reconfigure the integration with a valid charger ID and PIN.
